Everything the run unit owns except STATIC storage hangs off the RunUnit object (w68w). The static residue is closed by ONE adoption mechanism: every unit's static reset (a RECURSIVE program's / FUNCTION-ID's WS through ProgramTable.Register, a class's METHOD WS through its factory's __AdoptRunUnitStorage, called by RunUnit.FactoryObject when the run unit creates the factory) is adopted by the run unit, run at adoption (§14.6.2.3.2 1) and run again by RunUnit.Terminate - the ONE termination epilogue ProgramTable.RunMain's and RunUnit.Run's finally both call - so a POINTER in static WS no longer keeps its ALLOCATEd storage reachable past termination.
